build.buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm ci; else cd backend && npm ci; fi

deploy.preDeployCommand: export CHALIN03_EXPECTED_DATABASE="${CHALIN03_EXPECTED_DATABASE:-${DB_NAME:-$MYSQLDATABASE}}" && if [ -f scripts/runEquipmentFinanceOpeningDepositDeployRepair.js ]; then node scripts/runEquipmentFinanceOpeningDepositDeployRepair.js; else node backend/scripts/runEquipmentFinanceOpeningDepositDeployRepair.js; fi
deploy.startCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm start; else cd backend && npm start; fi
